title: SSC CGL Tier 1 - General Awareness Mock 01 (English & Hindi)

questions.question:
Which fundamental right cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency?
राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
options: Right to Equality / समानता का अधिकार
Right to Freedom of Speech / वाक् स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार
Right to Life and Personal Liberty / जीवन और व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता का अधिकार
Right to Constitutional Remedies / संवैधानिक उपचारों का अधिकार
questions.explanation: Articles 20 and 21 cannot be suspended during a National Emergency.

questions.question:
Who was the first Governor-General of Bengal?
बंगाल के प्रथम गवर्नर-जनरल कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Warren Hastings became the first Governor-General of Bengal under the Regulating Act of 1773.

questions.question:
Which instrument is used to measure atmospheric pressure?
वायुमंडलीय दबाव को मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
questions.explanation: A barometer is a scientific instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure.

questions.question:
In which year was the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) established?
भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
questions.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India was established on April 1, 1935 under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

questions.question:
Which is the largest river island in the world?
विश्व का सबसे बड़ा नदी द्वीप कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: Majuli Island in Assam, located on the Brahmaputra River, is the world's largest river island.
